style: A kinetic-type agency: electric blue bands with yellow, Anybody set heavy and uppercase over Rethink Sans, every discipline stretched along the width axis to fill the measure exactly, condensed numerals and wide headings.

concept.idea: An agency that takes on whatever the client needs has to flex. The type does it: one variable typeface whose width stretches to fit any word, so whatever six disciplines a company lists, each one fills the line edge to edge.
concept.signature: The hero is a stack of the six disciplines, each stretched to exactly the width of the page. On load they stretch out from narrow outlines one after another; under the pointer the stack bulges, the line nearest at full width in yellow and the others squeezed. Service titles widen on hover. Without JS the lines wrap at a fixed width; with reduced motion they are fitted and still.

jury.note: Self-score from the /jury rubric and shoot.mjs evidence (0 axe violations, no horizontal overflow at 390 or 1440 with the sample and with long.json, no tap target under 24 px, skip link first and every focus stop visible, no colour-only primary hover, nothing moving under reduced motion). No blind critic was run for this batch. A strong poster first frame: each discipline fitted edge to edge along the width axis, with a stretch-in intro and a pointer bulge. Very short or very long disciplines change the line height a lot (the fit scales size as well as width), which is part of the look but can feel uneven.
